use_cases: Airtight and weathertight sealing of horizontal and vertical laps on pliable building wraps
Detailing airtight envelope seams in energy-efficient residential and commercial construction
Sealing membrane interfaces around window and door joinery flashings
not_for: Complex curved 3D penetrations (use YouByute Flexi Tape)
retrieval.rag_summary:
ProctorPassive YouByute Sealing Tape represents a high-tack,
multi-purpose envelope sealing tape designed to join and seal ProctorWrap and
ProctorPassive building membranes. Formulated with an aggressive
pressure-sensitive adhesive on a robust carrier, it creates durable airtight and
weather-resistant bonds across membrane laps, timber framing, steel studs, and
building sheathing. It prevents air leakage and wind-driven rain penetration,
supporting energy-efficient building standards.
